title: Reuse-first artwork shortlist
scope: Read-only inspection; only this catalog and its Markdown companion were written. No art generation, mutation, queue change or runtime remapping. v4.12 adds 4 dedicated art aliases mapped to the same reviewed Noa files; 25 keys, 21 distinct images. v4.13 adds four star-dial aliases, 29 keys and the same 21 distinct card images; enemy reuses existing gatekeeper image. v4.14 growth trial adds two basic definitions reusing dark/guard keys; no new artwork or aliases. v4.15 adds four effect-first aliases using the same 21 distinct images; source pixels inspected 2026-10-07. New cards are growth-only rewards. v4.17 adds two frost-synergy aliases, using the same existing images as interim art; no generation. V4.19 adds the restitch alias to the existing star-bookmark image; no new image bytes. V4.20 candidate adds five mana/preparation aliases using individually reviewed existing art, without generation. V4.21 candidate adds rimeThaw, reusing pixel-inspected chant-ward.webp; no generation.
priority_order: Reuse a current v4 art key when its motif and set identity fit.
Reuse the verified existing legacy art key and embedded bytes for lower-risk prototypes.
Review the two existing Factory PNGs before commissioning new art.
Generate only when a named unmet visual need remains after the reuse check.
rights_boundary: No LICENSE, COPYING, NOTICE or image-rights grant was found among tracked repository files. Generator/prompts and git history document provenance, not legal ownership or redistribution permission. Do not label these public domain or cleared for unrelated projects.

validation.metadata_method: Pillow decoded dimensions/modes, file byte count, SHA-256, git history
validation.pixel_method: Original selected files opened individually with view_image; no contact-sheet-only judgments.

semantic_mismatches: manaBurst pixels show literal electric chains.
frostNova pixels show a tall ice wall.
chainBolt pixels show a broad energy surge.
notes: Preserve current game mappings; this audit does not authorize silent replacements.
The two semantic Factory filenames are different assets from similarly named embedded keys.
Most non-Noa assets have repository history only; do not infer a generator or rights owner.
Noa has a detailed generation report; Factory chain-lightning/abyss have generator and QA records.

selection_gate: Confirm the exact existing path and SHA-256; do not select by display name or stale manifest alone.
Match the visible subject, style group and mechanic; do not use shared art to blur distinct tactical choices.
Prefer an existing art key for prototypes. v4 is packaged independently, so do not add a ../assets dependency without deliberate packaging changes.
For future direct files, use a deterministic WebP optimization from the inspected PNG and retain the original; inspect final bytes before adoption.
Check the actual hand, reward gallery and detailed card at mobile and desktop sizes. Crop notes here are static-image review, not browser QA.
Record reuse as an explicit decision and why generation is unnecessary; only request new art for a remaining named gap.
